frontier.hypothesis: A pressure source whose OWN emission slot is not 23 closes the f3 family. f3 (exact in slots 1-22) and u5 (exact in slots 26-34) bracket target from opposite ends and their correct regions are complementary; the union of the two is the target body.
frontier.mechanism: The $v0 occupancy across insns 39..56 is what buys `lw $a1,0x10($v1)` at slot 12. In f3 it is bought with the idx load, which is dependence-free and therefore also the best filler for the load-delay slot at 23 - the slot target gives to the third `lw $a0,0x10($v1)`. A pressure source that is itself dependent on something late in the block cannot compete for slot 23 and should leave slots 23-31 alone.

frontier.hypothesis: A winning body must occupy BOTH $v0 and $a0 across p10's sched1 live range, not just $v0.
frontier.mechanism: Every body in the k-family (p10 read and its consumer moved into or above the copy triple) puts the load at slot 10 or 11 but in $a0, because local-alloc's scan finds $a0 free there.
